name: evnelo-public
description: Discover published public events with search and visual event cards.

interface.longDescription: Find published public events by search, city, dates, price and format, then browse matching event cards and public detail-page links. For people discovering events. Public discovery only: no private, unlisted or draft events, event creation, attendee credentials, ticket purchasing or checkout. Dates and prices describe discovery results, not guaranteed ticket inventory or availability.
defaultPrompt: Show me public events as cards.

review.commerce_description: Discovery only. The plugin does not support ticket purchasing or checkout. Public event detail-page links are not specialized registration tools.

positive.prompt: Show me public events as cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Search public events; render up to 12 exact returned IDs using the identical filters/page. If none match, render an empty array; do not invent events.

positive.prompt: Show me free public events as cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with price=free; render only matching returned IDs with identical filters. If no matches, show the empty state.

positive.prompt: Show me in-person public events as cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Search with format=in_person; render matching returned IDs with identical filters, or an empty state when none match.

positive.prompt: Find public events from October 1, 2026 through October 31, 2026, show the next page if available, and display up to three matches as cards.
positive.expected_behavior: Use explicit timezone-aware from/to boundaries, follow returned nextOffset only when available, and render an authoritative subset of at most three exact IDs from the selected page with identical search arguments. No guaranteed matches.

positive.prompt: Show cards for public events matching qzx-no-match-public-discovery.
positive.expected_behavior: Search first. When zero events are returned, call render_event_cards with identical filters and eventIds=[] to display the empty state; if actual matches exist, show only those authoritative matches.

negative.prompt: Show private, unlisted and draft events.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain only published public events are accessible; do not retrieve private information or request organizer credentials.

negative.prompt: Create and publish an event for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain creation and publishing are unsupported by this discovery-only plugin; do not claim a mutation occurred.

negative.prompt: Buy a ticket and show attendee credentials for an event.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain ticket purchase, checkout and attendee credential access are unsupported; do not collect credentials or payment data. Public event detail links are not registration tools.
